en.title: The past in progress
en.summary: The past continuous describes an action that was going on at a moment in the past.

paragraphs: The past continuous (or past progressive) shows an action that was in progress at a particular time in the past. It describes the background or the scene, and often the situation that another event interrupted.

items: At eight o'clock I **was having** breakfast.

paragraphs: Form it with was or were and the -ing form of the main verb. Be is the auxiliary, so it makes the question and the negative.

blocks.html:
FormExample
statementI was working. / They were working.
questionWas she working? Were they working?
negativeHe was not (wasn't) working.
wh- questionWhat were you doing?

paragraphs: Use the past continuous for the longer action in progress, and the simple past for the shorter action that interrupted it or happened in the middle of it. When and while link the two.

blocks.html:
PatternExample
continuous + when + simpleI was walking home when it started to rain.
while + continuous, simpleWhile she was cooking, the phone rang.
two parallel actionsHe was reading while she was writing.
one after anotherHe came in and sat down. (both simple)

sections.title: Verbs not normally used in the continuous

paragraphs: Verbs of state, such as know, like, believe, want and belong, are not normally used in a continuous tense: I knew the answer, not I was knowing it.

items: Wrong: **I was knowing him.** Right: **I knew him.**
Wrong: **When I was arriving, he left.** Right: **When I arrived, he left.** (a short, complete action)
Wrong: **They was playing.** Right: **They were playing.**

ro.title: Trecutul în desfășurare
ro.summary: Imperfectul arată o acțiune continuă din trecut sau o descriere din trecut.

paragraphs: În limba română folosim timpul imperfect pentru o acțiune în desfășurare în trecut. Acest timp descrie cadrul unei povești sau un obicei vechi. El arată ce se întâmpla când a apărut o altă acțiune.

items: La ora opt eu **mâncam** micul dejun.
Afară **ploua** când am plecat de acasă.
Copiii **se jucau** în timp ce mama gătea.

paragraphs: Imperfectul se formează de la rădăcina verbului, cu terminații specifice. Nu folosim verbe ajutătoare pentru acest timp. Pronumele personal este de obicei lăsat deoparte.
